# The module's channels as the leaf publishes them: leaf sensor index, channel name, kind, unit (the INFO table entry is `<index>:<kind>:<unit>:nicla-sense-me/<name>`).
# Kept byte for byte identical in furcate-leaf-firmware (test/host/vectors) and furcate-enterprise (crates/open/furcate-sense/tests/fixtures). The firmware test checks its table against this file, the enterprise test checks it against the cascade catalogue.

17 acc.y acceleration m/s2
18 acc.z acceleration m/s2
19 gyr.x angular_rate rad/s
20 gyr.y angular_rate rad/s
21 gyr.z angular_rate rad/s

23 prs pressure pascal
24 hum humidity percent
25 gas gas_resistance ohm
26 mag.x magnetic_field uT
27 mag.y magnetic_field uT
28 mag.z magnetic_field uT
29 rot.x orientation unitless
30 rot.y orientation unitless
31 rot.z orientation unitless
32 rot.w orientation unitless
33 iaq air_quality_index unitless
34 co2eq gas_equivalent ppm
35 bvoceq gas_equivalent ppm
36 steps step_count count
37 act activity_state count
